prompt:
Photorealistic product photography sprite sheet. Background: one perfectly flat, uniform, solid pure cobalt blue (#1F4FD1) chroma-key backdrop filling the entire frame, no gradient, no vignette, no texture, no floor, no cast shadows on the backdrop. Six separate vintage 1920s candy-shop sweets arranged in an even 3 by 2 grid, each item small enough to leave wide empty blue space around it so no two items touch or overlap and none touch the image edges. Items: (1) a round red-and-cream swirl peppermint hard candy in an opaque cream waxed-paper twist wrapper with twisted ends; (2) a teal-and-cream striped hard candy in an opaque teal waxed-paper twist wrapper; (3) a short classic red-and-white striped candy cane, hook facing right; (4) a single glossy cherry-red gumball; (5) a round red-and-cream spiral swirl lollipop on a white paper stick, tilted slightly; (6) a gold foil wrapped chocolate coin with a raised embossed letter C. All items fully opaque, no clear cellophane, no glass. Soft warm studio key light from the upper left, gentle highlights, crisp clean silhouettes, high detail, rich candy red, cream, teal and brass-gold tones. No text, no labels, no extra props, no hands.

[provenance] KIE gpt-image-2-5-flare-text-to-image, 3:2 2K, task c1b834ccacce1d92f5e7cde7db4ab0c5 (source sheet dev/hero/raw/sweets-sheet.png); item 'wrapped-red' keyed from the cobalt chroma to alpha (alpha ramp on b - max(r,g) 35 to 95, blue despill), cropped and resized to 440px on the long side.
